name: Content calendar month
oneLiner: a glass month grid turns in slow 3D, colour-coded post chips (video, short, post) drop onto days faster and faster while the scheduled count climbs, today's week fills in one sweep under a glowing band, then today lights with a ring and a pulse
say: when the speaker talks about planning or batching content ('I plan the whole month in one sitting', 'I post every single day'): the month fills under the setup, today lights on 'today' or 'every day'
